name: spacebook-dev-tests
description: Dev-only test tooling for SpaceBook. Nothing here is shipped: deploy.yml excludes package*.json, node_modules and tests/.

scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run smoke
scripts.test:reader: node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/reader/workspace.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/reader/cards.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/fills/browser.js
scripts.test:tools: node tests/createtest/data.js && node tests/grammar/data.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/createtest/browser.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/grammar/browser.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/tutor/browser.js
scripts.test:sync: node tests/sync/unit.js && node tests/sync/e2e.js && node tests/sync/items.js && node tests/sync/parity_e2e.js
scripts.parity: node tools/parity/check.js && node --max-old-space-size=8192 tools/parity/data_parity.js && node tests/parity/locator.js && node --max-old-space-size=6144 tests/plan/reminders.js && node tests/sync/entitlements.js
